cited.quote: During the year 2022-23, TANGEDCO commissioned 10 nos. of new 33/11 kV substations
the issues were resolved by energizing 8,905 new distribution transformers

rationale: C1, the 2023-24 policy note, reports that new 33/11 kV substations were commissioned in 2022-23 and 8,905 new distribution transformers energised, which is distribution infrastructure commissioned to secure supply. Only the year (2022-23) is stated, so the date is given as 2022. No generation project is shown as commissioned, so the evidence is moderate.

cited.quote: corona cash relief support @ Rs.4000/- in two instalments of Rs.2000/- each (May and June 2021)
99.2% of the rice cardholders availed the cash relief.

rationale: C2 reports Rs.4000 cash relief paid to 2,09,81,900 rice cardholders in two Rs.2000 instalments (May and June 2021), with 99.2% availing it. This matches the amount and the beneficiaries (all rice card holders). Payment was split in two instalments rather than one, which is a minor difference. The first instalment was May 2021.
